svg.title: Continual RL on 20-task GridWorld: min-max consolidation vs fine-tuning
svg.text: After learning 20 goals in a row, which ones can the agent still reach?
15x15 GridWorld · 20 goal-relocation tasks, learned one after another · 10 seeds · greedy evaluation, 100 rollouts
Does anything survive the next task?
Goals still solvable after each new task is trained, out of every goal learned so far.

g.text: Goals the agent can still solve

svg.text: every goal ever learned is still solvable
fine-tuning: only the two or three
A goal counts as kept while its value stays within 10% of what it was the moment that task finished training.
Goal by goal, at the end of the sequence
Fine-tuning keeps whatever it saw last. The constraint keeps everything.
Goal, in the order it was learned
over all 20 goals, at the end
Twenty tasks in a row, and the agent still solves all twenty.
Fine-tuning is left with about 3. No replay buffer, no stored transitions,
only a constraint that each new task must not undo the last.
